description: This file contains unit tests for the HPACK encoder implementation in the quiche HTTP/2 library, specifically testing the hpack_encoder.cc functionality including header encoding, dynamic table management, and string encoding strategies.

classes.name: HpackHeaderTablePeer
classes.description: A test peer class for accessing internal header table entries.

classes.name: HpackEncoderPeer
classes.description: A test peer class for accessing internal methods and state of HpackEncoder.

classes.name: HpackEncoderTest
classes.description: Unit test fixture class for testing HpackEncoder with various strategies.

methods.name: HpackHeaderTablePeer::GetFirstStaticEntry
methods.description: Returns the first static entry in the header table.

methods.name: HpackHeaderTablePeer::dynamic_entries
methods.description: Returns the dynamic entries table.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::compression_enabled
methods.description: Checks if compression is enabled in the encoder.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::table
methods.description: Returns the header table reference.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::table_peer
methods.description: Returns a peer object for the header table.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::EmitString
methods.description: Encodes a string using the encoder's string emission method.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::TakeString
methods.description: Retrieves the encoded string from the encoder.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::CookieToCrumbs
methods.description: Splits a cookie string into crumbs based on ';' delimiters.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::DecomposeRepresentation
methods.description: Splits a representation string into parts based on null bytes.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::EncodeHeaderBlock
methods.description: Encodes a header block into a string.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::EncodeIncremental
methods.description: Encodes headers incrementally into a string.

methods.name: HpackEncoderPeer::EncodeRepresentations
methods.description: Encodes header representations into a string.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the header table with entries for testing.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::SaveHeaders
methods.description: Stores observed headers for verification.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::ExpectIndex
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for an index.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::ExpectIndexedLiteral
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for an indexed literal header.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::ExpectNonIndexedLiteral
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for a non-indexed literal header.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::ExpectString
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for a string, choosing Huffman or identity.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::ExpectHeaderTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for a header table size update.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::MakeRepresentations
methods.description: Converts header set to representations for encoding.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::CompareWithExpectedEncoding
methods.description: Compares actual encoding output with expected.

methods.name: HpackEncoderTest::DynamicIndexToWireIndex
methods.description: Converts dynamic table index to HPACK wire index.
